title: A rolling mean without copying
prompt: Arrange the blocks into `rolling_mean(x, k)`: the mean of every window of `k` consecutive readings, so a 1-D array of length n gives n − k + 1 values. Use `sliding_window_view`, which builds a strided view of all windows without copying any data. Two blocks don't belong.
hints: Imports first, then the function. What shape does `sliding_window_view(x, k)` have for a length-n array?
It has shape (n − k + 1, k): one row per window. `reshape(-1, k)` instead chops x into non-overlapping pieces, which isn't a rolling window.
Average across each window, which is the last axis: `windows.mean(axis=-1)`.
